summary: Staff can register outbound webhook endpoints that receive signed, queued deliveries for publish, member, and subscription events.
detailed_changes: Added staff Webhooks UI and webhook_endpoints/deliveries tables with per-endpoint HMAC secrets.
Queued DeliverWebhookJob posts JSON with X-Newsroom-Signature (HMAC-SHA256) and retries with backoff without blocking publish.
Wired post.published, member.created, and subscription.updated event emission from editorial and membership flows.
affected_areas: User groups affected: staff; external webhook consumers
Internal impact: async outbound integrations; failures logged and retried
